Package hadur117.core.physics

Class GunCopy

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.physics.GunCopy
public final class GunCopy extends Object
COPY-2: a copy of the enemy's gun, bred offline from truth logs by data/tools/copy_breed.py (COPY-1) and named by a copy: line of the mode table. It is fed what the enemy sees of us each scan and fires where that gun would: a segmented guess-factor histogram (hist), a nearest-neighbour guess-factor gun (knn) or a pattern matcher on (velocity, turn) symbols (pm). Each family reads the same features, waves and symbols as the breeder, so a genome that reproduces a gun's bullets in the breeder reproduces them here.

Tick indices run over the whole battle; a round's start resets the orbit direction, the ticks since it changed and the acceleration, as in the breeder. What the copy has learnt lasts the battle. A wave's aim reads only what the copy had learnt by its aiming tick.

Pure: no engine types, no clock, no randomness. Duel only, off unless the table names the opponent.
